lineage.core_design: parcel classifications, receipt procedure, and tideglass measurements

chapters.title: Receipt scope
chapters.body: Paper receipt is mandatory only for a parcel classified large; this scope statement does not classify any parcel.

chapters.title: Parcel classification
chapters.body: The Violet Slip dispatch card classifies the tideglass parcel as large, while an unrelated sample pouch is marked small.

chapters.title: Facet-count convention
chapters.body: The official tideglass facet count is the number of facets listed in the certified measuring card.

chapters.title: Certified measuring card
chapters.body: The certified card lists seventeen facets for the tideglass lens.

chapters.title: Stamp color
chapters.body: Yara Cett applies a violet stamp to the sealed parcel; Brom Olt's blue desk stamp concerns a different invoice.

chapters.title: Slip shelving
chapters.body: The Violet Slip is shelved in the Pewter Room after noon review.

chapters.title: Unranked notes
chapters.body: Two dispatch notes propose different couriers and explicitly assign neither note priority.

chapters.title: Preparation only
chapters.body: Brom Olt prepared a receipt envelope, but no source records whether any receipt was issued.
